@@ -1,34 +0,0 @@
-# Calc
-
-## Tokens
-
-```gramaire tokens
-NUMBER : /[0-9]+/
-WS : /[ \t\r\n]+/   %skip
-```
-
-## expr
-
-```gramaire
-expr
-  : expr '+' term
-  | expr '-' term
-  | term
-```
-
-## term
-
-```gramaire
-term
-  : term '*' factor
-  | term '/' factor
-  | factor
-```
-
-## factor
-
-```gramaire
-factor
-  : '(' expr ')'
-  | NUMBER
-```
